name: pulsar_pasta
theme: a dive that never leaves one neutron star: the twenty-kilometre iron sphere seen from orbit, its crust cracked into plates with fissures burning between them and a beam flaring off each pole, down among the plates to a torn rift, into the crust's own grain of metal domains, into the ordered beads of matter at the crust's floor, and down into the star's deepest weave — spheres run into rods, rods merged into stacked sheets, sheets joined floor to floor by spiral ramps — which reads as the plated sphere and its spiralling beams all over again
music_theme: an iron star that breathes in beams and turns thirty times a second — a deep organ pulse on every downbeat, mineral and airless, thinning to one cold sustain through the crust's grain and the ordered beads, a wide struck bloom where the stacked sheets open out into the whole star, settling back to the pulse as the plates return

registers.name: star_orbit
registers.palette: sapphire beam glare, char-iron plates, ember-orange fissures, rust-violet haze
registers.scene: the whole neutron star hung in vacuum, a twenty-kilometre sphere of char-iron crust broken into hundreds of jammed plates, ember-orange fissures burning between every plate edge, two wan hot spots smouldering at the poles, a sapphire beam flaring from each pole and crossing the emptiness, rust-violet haze banked about the sphere, ink-deep vacuum past it with no ground and no horizon

registers.name: crust_rift
registers.palette: ember-orange rift glow, char-iron plate faces, thin sapphire wash
registers.scene: the crust plain seen from just over the plate tops, slabs of char-iron jammed together at crooked angles across the whole field, a rift torn open through the middle of them with ember-orange glow welling out of its depth, ridges of upthrust metal reared where two slabs press, glassy scree spilled down the rift flanks, a thin sapphire wash from the pole beams laid over the plate faces, rust-violet haze thickening toward the farthest plates

registers.name: crust_grain
registers.palette: pewter-blue domains, rust-violet seams, ember glints
registers.scene: the crust's own grain, pewter-blue metal domains packed shoulder to shoulder into a seamless mosaic, each domain terraced in flat steps, rust-violet seams marking every boundary where two domains meet at a crooked angle, ember points glinting in the deepest steps, a sapphire sheen laid over the terraces, ranks of domains repeating on every hand into violet gloom with no ground and no horizon

registers.name: coulomb_crystal
registers.palette: sapphire glow points, restless silver haze, violet depth-fog
registers.scene: an ordered swarm of glowing beads at the floor of the crust, every bead a hard point of sapphire glow, all of them locked into a perfect cubic lattice whose ranks run away past the frame, a restless silver haze flooding the spaces between the ranks, violet depth-fog thinning the farthest ranks, faint tremors passing through the ordered points, no ground, no horizon
registers.loop_target: ranks of glowing sapphire beads locked into a cubic lattice through a restless silver haze

registers.name: nuclear_pasta
registers.palette: ember-gold sheets, sapphire cut rims, ink-violet voids
registers.scene: the deepest weave of the star, files of glowing spheres joined end to end into unbroken ember-gold rods, the rods merged flank to flank into flat sheets stacked floor over floor, every floor joined to the next by a spiral ramp of the same glowing matter, sapphire rims picking out each sheet's cut edge, ink-violet voids filling the storeys between the sheets, the stack repeating away past the frame with no ground and no horizon
